preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 20,000.
The number of bricks is between 3 and 200,000.
The weight of each brick is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output for each test case is an integer representing the maximum possible final score.

invariants.description: The total number of bricks across all test cases does not exceed 200,000.
